summary: Practise SQL analysis, data-quality checks and lineage documentation for lake datasets. Explore the course and plan your next step.
lede: Data lake analytics uses SQL to explore, validate and interpret data stored in a lake environment. For analysts, data engineers and reporting specialists, the course covers a practical workflow for producing traceable reporting outputs. Learners profile schemas and data quality, query and join datasets with SQL and Apache Spark SQL, and document metadata and source-to-query lineage.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who query or prepare lake-stored data for analysis, reporting and operational decisions. It suits foundation-level learners who need a practical entry into SQL-led data lake analytics and its data-quality and governance controls.
prerequisites: No previous data lake administration experience is expected. Basic computer and spreadsheet familiarity will help; the course teaches foundational SQL querying, and general-purpose programming is required.
